messages:
Aaron - AE: Quick update — Nimbus Health wants to move from eval -> POC. Procurement sent back an MSA + Order Form with DPA redlines. Key asks: customer-managed KMS for hosted, EU-only data residency clause, and a 99.95% latency SLA even for POC. They also want the PO signed before MSA because of internal voucher rules. Need legal + ops take.

Priya (SE): POC notes: We tested on Dedicated EU nodes; latency median 45ms, p95 ~120ms with batching. 99.95% token-level SLA is aggressive for POC traffic. We can guarantee host locality and a dedicated pool for the trial.

Marta - Legal: Looking at the PDF redline. High-level: we cannot approve customer-managed KMS for Hosted/Shared environments. We can offer: (a) Hosted: Redwood-managed HSM (FIPS) + contractual assurances; (b) Dedicated/Private: BYOK/EKM under a separate addendum and engineering feasibility window.

Marta - Legal: Regarding PO-first signing, we can accept conditional PO if it contains express language that MSA must be executed prior to invoicing and that the PO is contingent on final MSA. I'll draft a one-sentence condition.

Tala - SalesOps: DocuSign note: Template tpl-nimbus-5 exists. System can put MSA + Order Form in same envelope with serial signing. If procurement must sign first, we can set signing order Proc -> Legal -> Exec, but Legal wants the MSA acknowledged before billing. We can add a boolean field in the PO "MSA_execution_pending": true and checkbox for buyer to agree.

FinanceBot: Finance rules: standard payment Net30. Customer requested Net60. For POC we can accept Net45 subject to credit hold and initial milestone payment. Require SOF (start-of-work) invoice if they want deferred payment.

Aaron - AE: They insisted on EKM for hosted. Can we offer a temporary workaround for the POC (like field-level tokenization or envelope-level customer key)?

Priya (SE): For short-term POC we can do dataset-level encryption with keys we manage, plus strict access controls and ephemeral logs. Not true CMK, but we can provide an attest to key separation and rotate keys post-trial. If they need real EKM integration, that's Dedicated/Private only and will add delivery lead time.

Marta - Legal: Draft clause for PO conditionality: "Buyer acknowledges that this Purchase Order is contingent upon execution of the Master Services Agreement. No invoices will be due or payable until the MSA is executed by both parties. Buyer may sign this PO for administrative processing but payment obligations are conditioned on MSA execution."

Tala - SalesOps: Will insert Marta's clause into the PO template and set routing. Which signer order do we want if procurement still demands to sign first?

Marta - Legal: If procurement signs first, they must initial the conditional clause. Preferred signer order: Legal -> Procurement -> Exec, but we can flip if they initial the contingency.

Aaron - AE: Customer also redlined SLA to include token-level latency credits and increased uptime. For POC we can offer a 'POC SLA' stating monitoring and weekly reports, but not financial credits. We'll commit to a production SLA discussion post-PoC.

Priya (SE): I'll prep an infra playbook for an EU-dedicated sandbox and include sample metrics (median latency, p95, cpu/gpu utilization). Also include suggested prompt throttling to hit their latency targets.

Tala - SalesOps: I'll create envelope tpl-nimbus-5 with MSA + Order Form, set conditional routing, and add a metadata field 'nimbus_eu_poc=true'. docusign-bot can populate serial order once Marta confirms exact language.

docusign-bot: Suggested envelope: template_id=tpl-nimbus-5, routing: serial. Default order: Legal -> Procurement -> Exec. Link: https://docusign.example.com/env/tpl-nimbus-5

FinanceBot: Action: if we move to Net45 require 25% upfront milestone invoice. Approvals required from Finance Head for Net60.

Marta - Legal: I'll upload the redline and the PO conditional language by EOD. Also adding the DPA update for EU-only residency: we can agree to process EU customer data in EU regions and include subprocessor list update.

Aaron - AE: Great. Next steps: Marta posts redline, Tala prepares envelope and routing, Priya shares infra runbook, Finance to confirm Net45 path. I'll circle back with Nimbus Health once redline live.

Tala - SalesOps: Creating Salesforce task and cc'ing Billing Ops.

Priya (SE): Will share runbook in this thread shortly.

Marta - Legal: Posting redline draft now: https://redwood.example.com/secure/attachments/nimbus-msaredline.pdf

Aaron - AE: Thanks all. I'll set up a 30-min sync with Nimbus for tomorrow morning to review the redline. :thumbsup:
